create_xavier_uniform_init: create Xavier uniform initialization for neural network weights with a given gain factor
create_kaiming_uniform_init: create Kaiming uniform initialization for ReLU activation layers using fan_in or fan_out mode
create_xavier_normal_init: create Xavier normal distribution initialization for linear and convolutional layer weights
create_kaiming_normal_init: create Kaiming normal distribution initialization for deep networks with ReLU or leaky_relu activations
create_orthogonal_init: create orthogonal matrix initialization for neural network weight tensors with at least 2 dimensions
